landing.faqQ1: Is it really 100% free? What does TipTang get?
landing.faqA1: Yes, really free. Tips flow from your fan's banking app straight into your PromptPay account. TipTang is only the alert/overlay layer — we're never in the middle of the money, so we literally can't take a cut.
landing.faqQ2: When does the money arrive? Any withdrawal wait?
landing.faqA2: It lands in your account the moment a fan pays, because PromptPay goes directly to your bank. No wallet holding, no withdrawal cycle.
landing.faqQ3: Is OBS setup hard? Will switching waste my time?
landing.faqA3: Not hard at all. Sign up, copy your overlay link, and drop it into OBS as a Browser Source — done in 5 minutes, with on-screen alerts and read-aloud (TTS) ready to go.
landing.faqA4: Switching takes under 5 minutes: sign up, add your PromptPay number and swap the OBS overlay link for TipTang's — then put your new donate link wherever the old one was.

guide.title: Get started with TipTang in 5 minutes
guide.intro: Follow these 5 steps and start receiving PromptPay donations on your stream — 100% free, no fees.

guide.obsStep3: Paste the copied OBS link into the URL field
guide.obsStep4: Set Width = 800, Height = 300 → OK, then drag or resize it anywhere (background is transparent automatically)
guide.step5Desc: Hit "Preview / test" on the OBS overlay page to see the alert pop up, then start your live and receive donations — 100% free, 0% fee, you keep every baht.

guide.why3: easy to switch, set up in 5 minutes

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: TipTang (data controller — contact support@tiptang.com) cares about your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use and protect your data under Thailand's Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).
privacy.s1Body:
• Account info: email, password (stored hashed — never the plain password), display name, bio, profile/cover images, social links
• If you sign in with Google: the email, name and profile picture Google provides to us (we never see your Google password)
• The creator's PromptPay ID (sensitive — stored securely server-side, never exposed to donors or the public)
• Donation info: supporter name/message, amount, transfer-slip image, transaction reference
• Reviews you post on the home page: the name you give, rating and comment
• Technical info: IP address (for rate-limiting and security, not stored permanently), a cookie that keeps you signed in, and anonymous page-view statistics via Vercel Analytics
privacy.s2Body:
• To run the service — receive donations, show stream alerts, and your profile page
• To confirm transfers and prevent slip reuse / fraud
• To email creators when a new donation arrives
• To maintain and secure the platform
We do not use your data for advertising and we do not sell it.
privacy.s3Body: Data is stored on Supabase infrastructure (database and file storage). Passwords are one-way hashed, and PromptPay IDs are never sent to the public client. We apply reasonable safeguards, but no system is 100% secure.
privacy.s4Body: We do not sell or rent your personal data. We may share data only as needed with the providers that run the platform: hosting and page-view statistics (Vercel), database/file storage (Supabase), email delivery, Google sign-in, and automatic slip verification — slip images are sent to Google (Gemini API) to read the amount and recipient and confirm the transaction — or when required by law.
privacy.s5Body: You have the right to access, obtain a copy of, correct, delete, or object to / withdraw consent for the processing of your personal data. Creators can delete their account themselves under Settings → Account security → Delete account. For the other rights, contact support@tiptang.com.
privacy.s6Body:
We keep data only as long as needed to provide the service.
• Payment slips and receipts: deleted automatically 90 days after the creator confirms or rejects the payment (180 days if never decided). We keep only the transaction reference, to stop the same slip being reused.
• When an account is deleted: its profile, tip history, shop, orders, slips and uploaded files are deleted immediately, except where the law requires us to keep something.
privacy.s7Body: For questions about this policy or to exercise your rights, contact us at support@tiptang.com

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Please read these terms before using TipTang. By signing up or using the service, you agree to them.
terms.s1Body: TipTang is a free tool that helps creators receive PromptPay donations and show on-stream alerts (overlays). TipTang is not an intermediary that holds or transfers funds — donations go directly from the supporter to the creator's bank/PromptPay account. Transfer slips are used only to confirm transactions.
terms.s2Body: TipTang is free to use, with no fees and no percentage cut from your donations (0%), because we never hold your money.
terms.s3Body:
• You must be at least 18, or have a parent or guardian's consent, to use the service
• You must provide accurate information, especially the PromptPay ID used to receive money
• You are responsible for keeping your account and password secure
• You are responsible for the content on your profile/stream and must comply with the law
• Donations are your own income — any related taxes are your responsibility. TipTang does not withhold tax or issue tax documents on your behalf
terms.s4Body: You may not use TipTang for fraud, money laundering, illegal activities or content, or infringing others' rights. We reserve the right to suspend accounts that violate these terms.
terms.s5Body: TipTang is provided "as is", without warranty that it will be error-free or always available. TipTang is not a bank, financial institution, or payment provider, and is not responsible for disputes, refunds, or transfer issues between supporters and creators, to the extent permitted by law. Payments made through PayPal are between the supporter and the creator on PayPal; TipTang does not receive them and cannot refund them.
terms.s6Body: You may stop using the service at any time, and request account deletion by emailing support@tiptang.com — we delete it within 7 days. We may improve or discontinue the service and may update these terms from time to time. Continued use means you accept the updated terms.
terms.s7Body: These terms are governed by the laws of Thailand. For questions, contact support@tiptang.com
terms.randomTitle: Fan features: random features, feature rewards and fan clip requests (e.g. the spin wheel, combo tip, clip requests)
terms.randomBody:
• Results of random features are drawn by the system; every slot has the same odds, and supporters can see every slot before tipping.
• Rewards must not be money, cash equivalents or items of monetary value.
• The creator is responsible for what is on their wheel, for carrying out results, and for following applicable law.
• TipTang only records and displays results; it does not run or guarantee any reward or task.
• Combo tip rewards (unlocked when viewers tip together to reach a level) follow the same rules: no money, cash equivalents or items of monetary value, and the creator is responsible for delivering the rewards they set.
• Clips or songs supporters request through "clip requests": the copyright and content of a clip are the responsibility of the requester and of the creator who chooses to play it on their stream. The creator may skip or not play any clip, and TipTang doesn't guarantee a clip will play on every platform.

featureHub.setHint: A priced sound only plays on tips that reach its price, picked or random · Images and videos in the set play at random with the card
featureHub.setNoFreeSound: Every sound in this set has a price; tips below all of them play with no sound
featureHub.setSaveFailed: Could not save, please try again
featureHub.setEmpty: This set has no files yet
featureHub.setImageRow: Image in the set, random with the card
featureHub.setVideoRow: Video in the set, plays instead of image and sound
featureHub.setAllIn: Every library file is already in this set
featureHub.setDeleteConfirm: Delete the set "{name}"? The files stay in the library.
featureHub.setDeleteActive: The set in use can't be deleted; switch to another set first
featureHub.csSub: A set is the mood of a stream, e.g. horror game, chatting, singing
featureHub.csStep2Hint: Sounds with "Fans can pick" off still play at random; fans just can't pick them · You can change this later
featureHub.csNoSounds: This set has no sounds, so there are no prices to set
featureHub.csVisualNote: {n} images and videos play at random with the card (fans don't pick images)
featureHub.d_soundpick: Fans pick a sound from today's set when they tip; set a minimum tip per sound
featureHub.switchHint: Every tip's alert sound and image + the sounds fans can pick
featureHub.saveInvalid: Not saved; check what you typed
featureHub.libRenameHint: Fans see this name when they pick a sound on your donate page
featureHub.d_wheel: Fans pay to spin a wheel; the result shows on stream and lands in your to-do list.
featureHub.d_combo: Fans tip in a row to fill the bar, level up and unlock the rewards you set, live on stream.
featureHub.d_media: Fans attach a YouTube clip to a tip; you approve it and it plays on stream from a queue.
featureHub.d_voice: Fans record a short voice message with their tip to play on stream — uses the same OBS link as clip requests.

wheel.pageDesc: Fans tick “Spin the wheel” when tipping. Once you confirm the tip, the wheel spins on stream and the result lands in your to-do list to tick off.
wheel.offNote: The wheel is off — fans don't see the spin option on your donate page yet.
wheel.noWheels: No wheels yet. Pick a template, then edit every slot.
wheel.pickIntro: Choose the closest one — you can edit every task afterwards.
wheel.tplDesc_task: The streamer does what comes up — sing, push-ups
wheel.tplDesc_reward: The tipping fan wins something, e.g. picks the next game · hits are removed
wheel.tplDesc_game: Change the rules of the game you're playing
wheel.tooMany: You have 20 wheels — delete one you don't use first.
wheel.inUseLong: This wheel is in use on your donate page
wheel.deleteConfirm: Delete the wheel “{name}”? Results already spun stay in your list.
wheel.name: Wheel name
wheel.priceHint: Fans must tip at least this to spin. With a picked sound, the prices add up.
wheel.removeWhenHit: Remove a slot once it comes up
wheel.removeWhenHitHint: Good for limited rewards: a slot that comes up is gone until you reset. When every slot is gone, the spin option disappears from your donate page.
wheel.slotsCapped: Lots of tasks: at most {max} slots per task (a wheel holds up to {limit} slots).
wheel.slotsHint: Every task gets the same number of slots, so every task has the same odds.
wheel.previewHint: Slots already taken out aren't shown. Slots of the same task are spread around the wheel.
wheel.testSent: Sent — check OBS (a test removes no slot and adds nothing to the list).
wheel.obsLine: Add each as its own Browser Source and place it anywhere.
wheel.todoDoneEmpty: Nothing marked done in the last 30 days.
wheel.rulesTitle: Before you turn on the wheel
wheel.rule1: Wheel rewards are not money, cash equivalents or anything with monetary value.
wheel.rule2: Fans can see every slot, and every slot has the same odds.
wheel.rule3: I'll carry out what the wheel shows or manage the list myself — this is my responsibility as the creator.
wheel.emptyNote: No slots left — fans won’t see the spin option until you press “Reset wheel”.

combo.howItWorks: 3 fans tipping within 5 minutes → a combo starts on stream · every tip adds 5 minutes · full bar = next level · afterwards a 1-hour break
combo.onlyWhenLinkOpen: Only works while the combo OBS link is open (confirmed tips only).
combo.cooldown: On a break — a new combo can start from {time}
combo.autoConfirmHint: Auto-confirm is off — combos only count confirmed tips, so turning it on makes them smoother.
combo.autoHint: Based on your real tips in the last 30 days (a usual tip is about ฿{typical}) · bigger tips, bigger bars.
combo.customHint: Type the baht for each level in the table below (starting from the numbers we worked out).
combo.noMoney: (no money or anything of monetary value)
combo.levelsHint: Baht = how much tipping clears that level · past the last level, bars stay the size of the last one · reaching a level adds its reward to your to-do list · changes apply to the next combo.
combo.testSent: Sent — check OBS (a ~35 s sample combo, not counted).

goalPage.typeHint_single: One bar that every tip fills (as before).
goalPage.typeHint_multi: List several things you want. Fans can pick which one their tip helps; no pick goes to the main item (the top one that isn't full).
goalPage.displayHint_main: Shows the main item with a "next" line.
goalPage.displayHint_all: Shows every item as a list (up to 4, then +N).
goalPage.displayHint_rotate: Shows one item at a time, 8 seconds each; an item that just got a tip comes up next.
goalPage.itemsHint: Money that lands on an item stays there — reordering or raising a price moves nothing · lowering a price below what's raised sends the extra to the next item · pictures are kept in your library.
goalPage.deleteFull: Delete "{name}"? It's fully funded — deleting it removes it from stream and the donate page; its money doesn't move.
goalPage.deleteMoves: "{name}" has ฿{amount} — deleting it moves that to {targets}.
goalPage.newRoundConfirm: Start a new round? Every bar goes back to 0 right away (old tips stay; your items stay).
goalPage.previewHint: This preview uses your real totals. Your existing OBS link keeps working.

mediaPage.howItWorks: Fans attach a YouTube link to their tip. Once the tip is confirmed the clip joins the queue (waiting for your approval, or straight in with auto-approve) and plays on stream in order through this feature's OBS link.
mediaPage.pausedNote: Queue on hold: the clip playing finishes, the next one doesn't start.
mediaPage.queueHint: Clips join the queue only once their tip is confirmed. Rejecting the tip takes the clip out (one playing stops) · With this feature off, queued clips stay but don't play.
mediaPage.minAmountHint: Adds up with the sound-pick and wheel prices when a fan picks several.
mediaPage.autoApproveHint: Clips go straight into the queue without approval (you can always skip).
mediaPage.obsAudioHint: In OBS, tick "Control audio via OBS" on this Browser Source to set the clip volume apart from other sounds.
mediaPage.testSent: Test clip added to the front of the queue.
mediaPage.testWaits: Test clip added — it plays once this feature is on and the queue isn't on hold.
mediaPage.warn1: Clips fans send will play on stream right away, without you seeing them first.
mediaPage.warn2: You're responsible for the content and copyright of what plays on your stream.
mediaPage.warn3: Streaming platforms (e.g. YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, Facebook) may mute, remove videos or penalise your channel for copyrighted music or clips.
mediaPage.warn4: You can skip any clip at any time and turn auto-approve off whenever you like.
mediaPage.warnAccept: I understand and accept the copyright risk
mediaPage.voiceHow: Fans record a short voice message (up to 30 seconds) with their tip. It joins the same queue as clips and plays through the same OBS link. You can press "Listen" before approving.
mediaPage.voiceAutoHint: Voice messages go straight into the queue without approval (you can always skip).
mediaPage.voiceKeepHint: Voice files are kept private and deleted automatically 7 days after they play, are skipped or rejected (30 days at most) · removing one from the queue deletes it at once.
mediaPage.voiceTestWaits: Test sound added — it plays once voice messages are on and the queue isn't on hold.
mediaPage.voiceWarn1: Voice messages fans record will play on stream right away, without you hearing them first.
mediaPage.voiceWarn2: They may contain swearing, inappropriate sounds or someone else's personal details.
mediaPage.voiceWarn3: You're responsible for what plays on your stream, and streaming platforms may penalise your channel for content that breaks their rules.
mediaPage.voiceWarn4: You can skip any voice message at any time and turn auto-approve off whenever you like.
mediaPage.voiceWarnAccept: I understand and accept the risk of playing voices I haven't heard first
